VAR StartDate = FIRSTDATE(MasterDate[date])
VAR EndDate = LASTDATE(MasterDate[date])
VAR StartDay = IF(ISBLANK(StartDate), BLANK(), DAY(StartDate))
VAR EndDay = IF(ISBLANK(EndDate), BLANK(), DAY(EndDate))
VAR EOM = IF(ISBLANK(EndDate), BLANK(), EOMONTH(EndDate, 0))
VAR SOM = IF(ISBLANK(StartDate), BLANK(), DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1))
VAR MonthsDiff =
    IF(
        OR(ISBLANK(StartDate), ISBLANK(EndDate)),
        0,
        DATEDIFF(StartDate, EndDate, MONTH) + 1
    )

// Kondisi 1: Full month (start = 1 dan end = akhir bulan)
VAR ResultFullMonth =
    VAR PrevStartDate = EDATE(SOM, -MonthsDiff)
    VAR PrevEndDate = EOMONTH(EDATE(SOM, -1), 0)
    RETURN
        "*LP = Last Period " &
        FORMAT(PrevStartDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy") & " - " &
        FORMAT(PrevEndDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy")

VAR PrevMonthEOM = EOMONTH(EDATE(EndDate, -1), 0)  // Tanggal akhir bulan bulan sebelumnya
VAR PrevStartDate = EDATE(StartDate, -1) // DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate) - 1, DAY(StartDate))
VAR PrevEndDate =
    IF(
        EndDate = EOM,  // Jika EndDate adalah tanggal akhir bulan
        IF(
            DAY(EndDate) = DAY(PrevMonthEOM),  // Jika tanggal EndDate sama dengan tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
            PrevMonthEOM,                      // Gunakan tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
            IF(
                DAY(EndDate) < DAY(PrevMonthEOM),  // Jika tanggal EndDate kurang dari tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
                DATE(YEAR(PrevMonthEOM), MONTH(PrevMonthEOM), DAY(EndDate)),  // Gunakan hari sama dengan EndDate di bulan sebelumnya
                PrevMonthEOM  // Jika tanggal EndDate lebih dari tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya, gunakan tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
            )
        ),
        DATE(YEAR(EndDate), MONTH(EndDate) - 1, DAY(EndDate))  // Jika bukan tanggal akhir bulan, gunakan hari sama di bulan sebelumnya
    )
VAR ResultSameMonth =
    "*LP = Last Period " &
    FORMAT(PrevStartDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy") & " - " &
    FORMAT(PrevEndDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy")

// Kondisi 3: Bukan full bulan & start, end di bulan berbeda
VAR PrevStartDateDiff = EDATE(DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), DAY(StartDate)), -(MonthsDiff - 1))
VAR PrevEndDateDiff =
    IF(
        EndDate = EOM,  // Jika EndDate adalah tanggal akhir bulan
        IF(
            DAY(EndDate) = DAY(EOMONTH(DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1), 0)),  // Jika tanggal EndDate sama dengan tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
            EOMONTH(DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1), 0),                      // Gunakan tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
            IF(
                DAY(EndDate) < DAY(EOMONTH(DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1), 0)),  // Jika tanggal EndDate kurang dari tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
                DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), DAY(EndDate)),  // Gunakan hari sama dengan EndDate di bulan sebelumnya
                EOMONTH(DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1), 0)  // Jika tanggal EndDate lebih dari tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya, gunakan tanggal akhir bulan sebelumnya
            )
        ),
        DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), DAY(EndDate))  // Jika bukan tanggal akhir bulan, gunakan hari sama di bulan sebelumnya
    )
VAR ResultDiffMonth =
    "*LP = Last Period " &
    FORMAT(PrevStartDateDiff, "mmm/dd/yyyy") & " - " &
    FORMAT(PrevEndDateDiff, "mmm/dd/yyyy")
RETURN
IF(
    [is_startdate_LP_Blank] = 1,
    "*LP = Last Period N/A -",
    IF(
        StartDay = 1 && EndDate = EOM,
        ResultFullMonth,
        IF(
            MONTH(StartDate) = MONTH(EndDate),

)

                IF(
                    IsFullMonth,

                )
            RETURN
                "Last Period: "
                    & FORMAT(PrevStartDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy")
                    & " - "
                    & FORMAT(PrevEndDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy"),
            //// MTD & Custom Period
            VAR StartDay = DAY ( StartDate )
            VAR EOM = EOMONTH ( EndDate, 0 )
            VAR SOM = DATE ( YEAR ( StartDate ), MONTH ( StartDate ), 1 )
            VAR MonthsDiff = DATEDIFF ( StartDate, EndDate, MONTH ) + 1 
            // Full Month
            VAR ResultFullMonth =
                VAR PrevStartDate = EDATE ( SOM, - MonthsDiff )
                VAR PrevEndDate = EOMONTH ( EDATE ( SOM, -1 ), 0 )
                RETURN
                    "Last Period: " & FORMAT ( PrevStartDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy" ) & " - "
                        & FORMAT ( PrevEndDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy" )     
            // Same Month
            VAR PrevMonthEOM = EOMONTH ( EDATE ( EndDate, -1 ), 0 )
            VAR PrevStartDate = EDATE ( StartDate, -1 )
            VAR PrevEndDate =
                IF (
                    EndDate = EOM,
                    MIN (
                        PrevMonthEOM,
                        DATE ( YEAR ( PrevMonthEOM ), MONTH ( PrevMonthEOM ), DAY ( EndDate ) )
                    ),
                    EDATE ( EndDate, -1 )
                )
            VAR ResultSameMonth = "Last Period: " & FORMAT ( PrevStartDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy" ) & " - "
                    & FORMAT ( PrevEndDate, "mmm/dd/yyyy" ) 
            // Different Month
            VAR PrevStartDateDiff = EDATE ( StartDate, - ( MonthsDiff - 1 ) )
            VAR PrevEndDateDiff =
                IF (
                    EndDate = EOM,
                    EOMONTH ( StartDate, 0 ),
                    DATE ( YEAR ( StartDate ), MONTH ( StartDate ), DAY ( EndDate ) )
                )
            VAR ResultDiffMonth = "Last Period: " & FORMAT ( PrevStartDateDiff, "mmm/dd/yyyy" ) & " - "
                    & FORMAT( PrevEndDateDiff, "mmm/dd/yyyy" )
            RETURN
                IF(
                    StartDay = 1 && EndDate = EOM,
                    ResultFullMonth,
                    IF ( MONTH ( StartDate ) = MONTH ( EndDate ), ResultSameMonth, ResultDiffMonth )
                )
        )
    )

VAR PeriodType = SELECTEDVALUE('Period Type'[Period], "MTD")
VAR StartDate = FIRSTDATE(MasterDate[date])
VAR EndDate = LASTDATE(MasterDate[date])
VAR StartDay = DAY(StartDate)
VAR EOM = EOMONTH(EndDate, 0)
VAR SOM = DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1)
VAR IsFullMonth = StartDay = 1 && EndDate = EOM
VAR MonthsDiff = DATEDIFF(StartDate, EndDate, MONTH) + 1

RETURN
IF(
    [is_startdate_LP_Blank] = 1,
    BLANK(),
    SWITCH(
        PeriodType,
        // YTD
        "YTD",
            EDATE(StartDate, -12),
        // MTD / Custom Period
        VAR PrevStartDateFullMonth = EDATE(SOM, -MonthsDiff)
        VAR PrevStartDateSameMonth = EDATE(StartDate, -1)
        VAR PrevStartDateDiffMonth = EDATE(StartDate, -(MonthsDiff - 1))
        RETURN
            IF(
                IsFullMonth,
                PrevStartDateFullMonth,
                IF(
                    MONTH(StartDate) = MONTH(EndDate),
                    PrevStartDateSameMonth,
                    PrevStartDateDiffMonth
                )
            )
    )
)

VAR PeriodType = SELECTEDVALUE('Period Type'[Period], "MTD")
VAR StartDate = FIRSTDATE(MasterDate[date])
VAR EndDate = LASTDATE(MasterDate[date])
VAR StartDay = DAY(StartDate)
VAR EOM = EOMONTH(EndDate, 0)
VAR SOM = DATE(YEAR(StartDate), MONTH(StartDate), 1)
VAR IsFullMonth = StartDay = 1 && EndDate = EOM
VAR MonthsDiff = DATEDIFF(StartDate, EndDate, MONTH) + 1

RETURN
IF(
    [is_startdate_LP_Blank] = 1,
    BLANK(),
    SWITCH(
        PeriodType,
        // YTD
        "YTD",
            IF(
                IsFullMonth,
                EOMONTH(EDATE(EndDate, -12), 0),
                EDATE(EndDate, -12)
            ),
        // MTD / Custom Period
        VAR PrevMonthEOM = EOMONTH(EDATE(EndDate, -1), 0)
        VAR PrevEndDateSameMonth =
            IF(
                EndDate = EOM,
                MIN(
                    PrevMonthEOM,
                    DATE(
                        YEAR(PrevMonthEOM),
                        MONTH(PrevMonthEOM),
                        DAY(EndDate)
                    )
                ),
                EDATE(EndDate, -1)
            )
        VAR PrevEndDateDiffMonth =
            IF(
                EndDate = EOM,
                EOMONTH(StartDate, 0),
                DATE(
                    YEAR(StartDate),
                    MONTH(StartDate),
                    DAY(EndDate)
                )
            )
        RETURN
            IF(
                IsFullMonth,
                EOMONTH(EDATE(SOM, -1), 0),
                IF(
                    MONTH(StartDate) = MONTH(EndDate),
                    PrevEndDateSameMonth,
                    PrevEndDateDiffMonth
                )
            )
    )
)
